# Muhammad Gaweesh

> Pharmacist turned software developer, based in Cairo, Egypt. Builds full-stack web apps and platforms for healthcare, education, commerce and consulting — end to end, from product decisions to deployment.

Muhammad trained as a pharmacist and later moved into software development, carrying the same habit into both: check what a thing interacts with before you hand it over. He builds and ships production platforms rather than demos, and stays involved after launch.

## Work

- [MedCoreX](https://medcorex.org): Clinical decision-support platform for pharmacists — therapy monitoring, dosing, antimicrobial stewardship and pre-emptive alerts. Stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Docker.
- [Sci Bridge](https://sci-bridge.org): Learning platform for scientists — on-demand courses, live sessions, payments, email automation and instant certificate generation.
- [Tahfiz Quran Academy](https://tahfizquran.org/): Bilingual (Arabic/English) one-to-one Qur'an teaching platform with timezone-aware trial booking, recurring lessons, subscriptions and verifiable certificates.
- [Techno Core](https://bta3al3ab.online/): Arabic-language game discovery hub — system requirements, community content and search, built with plain PHP and MySQL.
- [Obelisk Solutions](https://obelisk-solutions.com/): Multilingual marketing site for an international consultancy.
- [Mamlakty](https://mamlakty.com/): Mobile-first e-commerce store for mothers and children (WooCommerce).
- [Prof. Amal Kamal](https://profamalkamal.com/): Bilingual academic platform for research, lectures and training news.
- [Dr. Ahmed Osama](https://ahmedos.pages.dev/): Personal brand site optimized for fast loading on poor connections.
- [Dr. Mohamed Yahia](https://drmyahia.pages.dev/): Medical information and booking site.
